entities.summary: Strike Entertainment was a short-lived American production company founded in 2002 by Marc Abraham, Thomas Bliss and Eric Newman. Strike's films were distributed through Universal Pictures as well as various other majors. Its first film produced was The Rundown starring The Rock. The company was dissolved in March 2013.
